headline: Divided Supreme Court Rules That Trump’s White House Ballroom Can Proceed
summary: Associate Digital Editor, ARTnews and Art in America The construction of President Donald Trump’s luxury ballroom will proceed as planned and replace the East Wing of the White House , a divided Supreme Court ruled on Monday, the New York Times reported. Stopping the construction of the project, the Trump administration argued in the ruling, was a national security concern. © 2026 Art Media, LLC.

headline: Mark Feary to Curate 2028 Adelaide Biennial
summary: The Art Gallery of South Australia (AGSA) has named Mark Feary as the curator of the next Adelaide Biennial of Australian Art, to take place March 3–June 4, 2028.
